# CleanBG

> Free in-browser background remover. Photos are never uploaded.

- Home: https://cleanbg.app/
- White background: https://cleanbg.app/white-background
- Transparent PNG: https://cleanbg.app/transparent-png
- Logo: https://cleanbg.app/logo
- Portrait background (not an official ID photo): https://cleanbg.app/passport-photo
- iPhone HEIC: https://cleanbg.app/iphone-heic
- Blog: https://cleanbg.app/blog
- Privacy: https://cleanbg.app/privacy-policy
- Terms: https://cleanbg.app/terms-of-service
- Licenses: https://cleanbg.app/licenses

Processing uses MIT-licensed ONNX models (BEN2, BiRefNet lite) via Transformers.js and ONNX Runtime Web, running in a Web Worker on the visitor's device. There is no image-upload API. Chinese pages live under /zh/.
